test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'MANIA' is written as 'NZOHZ' and 'PROUD' is written as 'QSNTE'. How will 'DONKEY' be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b214ea814e84e3c04bfbf6556204b42b6e388b2bc3d8de0d6fae023955bb398.png] The logic followed here is :- **Consonants are added +1 of alphabet positional value.** **Vowels are subtracted -1 of alphabet positional value.** 'MANIA' is written as 'NZOHZ'.
